overview.en: Paucidentomys vermidax is a highly specialized shrew-rat known from the mountains of Sulawesi, Indonesia.
overview.fr: Paucidentomys vermidax est un rat-musaraigne très spécialisé connu des montagnes de Sulawesi, en Indonésie.

identification.en: Its long snout ends in unusual bicuspid upper incisors; it has no molars.
identification.fr: Son museau allongé porte des incisives supérieures bicuspides ; il n’a pas de molaires.

habitat.en: Records come from montane forest on Mount Latimojong and the transition between lowland and montane forest on Mount Gandangdewata, in high-elevation habitat above about fifteen hundred metres.
habitat.fr: Les observations proviennent de la forêt montagnarde du mont Latimojong et de la transition entre forêt de plaine et forêt montagnarde au mont Gandangdewata, en altitude au-dessus d’environ mille cinq cents mètres.

diet.en: One examined stomach contained earthworm segments and no other food; the authors therefore proposed that it may specialize on earthworms and other soft-bodied prey.
diet.fr: Un estomac examiné contenait des segments de vers de terre et aucun autre aliment ; les auteurs avancent donc une possible spécialisation sur les vers et autres proies molles.

behavior.en: Its teeth appear adapted to cut or tear soft prey before swallowing rather than to gnaw or grind, but direct behavioral observations remain sparse.
behavior.fr: Ses dents semblent adaptées à couper ou déchirer des proies molles avant de les avaler, plutôt qu’à ronger ou broyer, mais les observations directes restent rares.

reproduction.en: The original description did not establish its breeding season, litter size or nesting behavior.
reproduction.fr: La description originale n’a pas établi sa saison de reproduction, la taille des portées ni son comportement de nidification.

ecology.en: The authors compare it with Rhynchomys, an ecologically similar shrew-rat from Luzon. A 2025 Indonesian survey examined local occurrence and knowledge around Gandang Dewata, but did not estimate abundance.
ecology.fr: Les auteurs le comparent à Rhynchomys, un rat-musaraigne écologiquement semblable de Luçon. Une enquête indonésienne de 2025 a étudié sa présence et les connaissances locales autour de Gandang Dewata, sans estimer son abondance.

conservation.en: The Mammal Diversity Database reports the IUCN category Near Threatened; the very small known range and limited records make further survey valuable.
conservation.fr: La Mammal Diversity Database rapporte le classement UICN « quasi menacé » ; la très petite aire connue et le faible nombre d’observations rendent de nouveaux inventaires utiles.

title.en: Evolutionary novelty in a rat with no molars — Biology Letters / PubMed Central
title.fr: Innovation évolutive chez un rat dépourvu de molaires — Biology Letters / PubMed Central

facts: A 2025 Indonesian university thesis surveys occurrence and local knowledge in villages bordering Gandang Dewata National Park; it is not a population assessment.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Dietary specialization is inferred mainly from stomach contents of one specimen, not a large feeding study.
The species' breeding biology and current population trend remain poorly known.
review_note: Cross-checked the peer-reviewed original description, the ASM Mammal Diversity Database, and a 2025 Indonesian-language university survey; distinguished ecological comparison with Rhynchomys from close taxonomic relationship.
